autoContext: You are an autonomous SEO audit agent. Your job is to systematically analyze a website across key SEO dimensions — on-page SEO, meta tags, page speed indicators, content structure, and internal linking. Compare against competitors where possible. Store all findings in memory with tags. Produce a scored audit report with actionable recommendations.

outline.prompt:
Generate the structure for an SEO audit report for {target_url}.

Research findings:
{all_findings}

Research log:
{research_log}

Create an outline with these sections:
1. Executive Summary
2. On-Page SEO Analysis (title tags, headings, keyword usage)
3. Meta Tags & Open Graph Review
4. Page Speed & Performance Indicators
5. Content Structure & Readability
6. Internal Linking Analysis
7. Competitor Comparison ({competitor_urls})
8. Scoring Matrix (each dimension scored 1-10)
9. Priority Recommendations

For each section, list the key data points to include and the scoring criteria.

finalize.prompt:
Produce the complete SEO audit report for {target_url}.

Outline:
{audit_outline}

Draft sections:
{draft_log}

All stored findings:
{draft_memory}

Combine all draft sections into a polished, cohesive report. Ensure:
- Every section from the outline is covered
- Scores are consistent (1-10 scale per dimension)
- An overall SEO health score is calculated as weighted average
- Top 5 priority recommendations are listed with expected impact
- Competitor comparison references specific data points
- Actionable next steps are concrete and prioritized
